svg.title: Mohamed Rayen Sansa — AI & Machine Learning Engineer
svg.desc: My name stored the way a neural network stores it: each letter as two numbers, the latent code of a trained autoencoder, then decoded back into pixels by the network, one letter after another.

g.text: AI & Machine Learning Engineer · ESPRIT engineering student · PFE from Feb 2027
each letter is stored as 2 numbers by a denoising autoencoder (35-16-2-16-35) and drawn back by its decoder · mohamedrayensansa.me
